recognize_zh: 一群中到大型母細胞，染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質中等量呈灰藍色且無顆粒，部分有小空泡；下方一顆母細胞細胞質拉長成尾巴（hand-mirror）。形態不具特異性，PICALM::MLLT10 需分子檢測確認。
features: Cluster of medium-to-large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli in some cells
Moderate amount of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm, occasionally with small punched-out vacuoles
One blast with a polarized cytoplasmic tail producing hand-mirror morphology
No Auer rods visible; several disrupted/smudged cells with reticular chromatin in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive-appearing cluster of medium-to-large blasts with oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate, lightly basophilic and agranular, with occasional small vacuoles; one blast shows a single elongated cytoplasmic tail (hand-mirror form). No Auer rods are seen, and there are scattered disrupted cells in the background. The morphology is that of an acute leukemia with nonspecific, minimally differentiated blasts; lineage assignment and the PICALM::MLLT10 fusion require flow cytometry and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: PICALM::MLLT10 also occurs in T-ALL, and aberrant CD7 is common in this AML, so cCD3 versus MPO on flow is required to separate them.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Monoblasts usually have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive; KMT2A FISH distinguishes the fusion partner.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical and separation relies on detection of the PICALM::MLLT10 fusion by RT-PCR, FISH or sequencing.
B-ALL blasts typically have scantier cytoplasm and are CD19/CD79a/TdT positive without myeloid antigens.
